slide1.headline: Swedish Oplane Raises €4.5M
slide1.subtitle: Seed funding to automate threat modeling for AI coding teams

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 02 Jun 2026
Swedish Oplane has raised €4.5M in seed funding.
The funding will be used to automate threat modeling for AI coding teams.
This investment highlights the growing importance of AI security.
The €4.5M investment will help Oplane expand its operations.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding will enable Oplane to develop its threat modeling platform.
This platform will help AI coding teams identify and mitigate potential security risks.
The investment is a significant boost to the AI security sector.
It demonstrates the growing recognition of AI security as a critical aspect of AI development.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: Oplane's funding is a significant development in the AI security space.
The investment will help drive innovation in AI threat modeling.
The AI security sector is expected to continue growing in the coming years.

MiniMax M3 has debuted, eclipsing GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro on key benchmark performance.
The MiniMax M3 achieves this performance at just 5-10% of the cost.
